scenes.title: Scouting and Departure
scenes.rationale: The morning planning frame includes an explicit flashback to reconnaissance, then returns to the same decision about the day’s destination and transport.
scenes.overview: Scout the dragon’s territory, leave Dimitaur, and choose to fly to the tower.
scenes.transitionToNext: The ospreys depart and approach the tower.

scenes.title: Entering the Black Tower
scenes.rationale: Travel culminates in a contested entry through the rooftop hatch; reaching the enclosed ritual chamber changes the immediate situation.
scenes.overview: Fly west with the animated ladder and escape the rooftop guardians through the hatch.
scenes.transitionToNext: Inside the chamber, the party examines the manacles while the guardians pursue.

scenes.title: Manacles and Stone Guardians
scenes.rationale: The brief identification occurs while the same pursuers are closing in; it leads directly into the defensive fight on the stairs.
scenes.overview: Identify the soulbinding manacles and destroy the pursuing guardians at the stairs.
scenes.transitionToNext: With the threat defeated, the party can heal and consult the mirror.

scenes.title: The Dagger in the Mirror
scenes.rationale: Recovery and the choice of a mirror question lead into one focused investigation of the phylactery.
scenes.overview: The mirror reveals Apollyon’s dagger phylactery and the ritual used to create it.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party leaves the ritual chamber and searches lower floors.

scenes.title: Books and Haunted Rooms
scenes.rationale: A continuous descent through ruined upper floors centers on finding books and bypassing the unexplored moving-metal room.
scenes.overview: Recover two magical books, bypass moving metal, and loot the living quarters.
scenes.transitionToNext: At ground level, Wellby opens the audience chamber.

scenes.title: Skeletons and the Descent Below
scenes.rationale: At the user’s request, this scene includes the skeleton chamber, throne removal, rest, forge reconnaissance, and door trap, ending immediately before the call for initiative at u6508.
scenes.overview: Destroy the skeletons, remove the throne, rest, scout the forge, and trigger its door trap.
scenes.transitionToNext: After the fireball resolves, initiative begins against the sword and force hands.

scenes.title: The Forge’s Defenders
scenes.rationale: At the user’s request, this scene begins with initiative at u6508 and contains only the uninterrupted forge battle, through the destruction of the last force hand.
scenes.overview: Fight the void sword, its splitting daggers, and the force hands.
scenes.transitionToNext: With the defenders gone, the party searches the forge and its side rooms.

scenes.title: Secrets and the Return to Dimitaur
scenes.rationale: The user requested merging the forge investigation and its aftermath at Dimitaur’s temple into one final scene.
scenes.overview: Recover treasures, decipher the forge instructions, and return to Dimitaur, who burns the lich book.
